column6: desc
Standing, aeroplane style: both arms raised as wings – tilting from side to side
Standing, akimbo style: hands on hips
Standing, angry style: swing lower arms aggressively - fists closed
Standing, arms above head style: arms raised straight above head
Standing, arms behind back style: hands clasped behind back
Standing, arms by side style: keep arms fixed by side and do not move them
Standing, arms folded style: right arm folded over left
Standing, balance style: arms out to side for balance - tilting side to side
Standing, beat chest style: beat chest while moving normally
Standing, bent forward style: tilt torso forwards
Standing, bent knees style: bend knees as much as possible
Standing, big steps style: as large steps as possible
Standing, bouncy left style: step normally with right foot but spring off left foot
Standing, bouncy right style: step normally with left foot but spring off right foot
Standing, cat style: use hands as paws - step opposite hand and foot
Standing, chicken style: bob head - arms as wings
Standing, cross over style: step each foot in front of other leg
Standing, crouched style: squat slightly and bend back
Standing, crowd avoidance style: occasionally turning shoulders or turn sideways to avoid others
Standing, depressed style: head bowed arms swinging
Standing, dinosaur style: like a t-rex arms close to body dinosaur posture
Standing, drag left leg style: drag left foot along the floor
Standing, drag right leg style: drag right foot along the floor
Standing, drunk style: stumbling around at random. Various foot step sizes and arm motions
Standing, duck foot style: toes pointing inwards
Standing, elated style: swing arms with spring
Standing, fairy steps style: one foot in front of the other so the heel touches the toe
Standing, flapping style: flap arms as wings on tiptoes
Standing, flick legs style: knees together and flick legs to sides as moving
Standing, followed style: check behind occasionally
Standing, graceful arms style: one arm across chest the other extended walk tall
Standing, hands between legs style: bent back – legs wide - hands swing between legs
Standing, hands in pockets style: place hands in pockets and walk and run
Standing, heavyset style: walking as a muscle man tensed biceps
Standing, high knees style: lift knees high but only knees – not marching
Standing, in the dark style: feeling around as if in darkness
Standing, karate chop style: open hands swing hand with each step to do a karate chop
Standing, kick style: kick with every step
Standing, lawn mower style: roll hands over one another like disco move and tilt torso forwards and then back
Standing, lean back style: bent backwards
Standing, lean left style: normal motion upperbody tilted right
Standing, lean right style: normal motion upperbody tilted left
Standing, left hop style: hop on left foot
Standing, legs apart style: legs relatively straight wide apart
Standing, limp left style: keep left leg straight and limp
Standing, limp right style: keep right leg straight and limp
Standing, look up style: tilt head to look at ceiling
Standing, lunge style: wide step bend knee every step in lunge position
Standing, march style: high knees swing arms at elbows
Standing, monk style: interlock hands in front of pelvis head slightly bowed
Standing, morris style: swing hands side to side as if waving hankies. Bouncy/skipping footsteps
Standing, neutral style: normal walking
Standing, old style: hunchbacked move very slowly
Standing, on heels style: walk on heels with toes raised
Standing, on phone left style: holding phone in left
Standing, on phone right style: holding phone in right
Standing, on toes bent forward style: as bent forward style but on tip toes
Standing, on toes crouched style: as crouched style but on tip toes
Standing, pendulum hands style: squat slightly make right angle with elbows and swing hands freely
Standing, penguin style: waddle with feet close together
Standing, pigeon toed style: toes turned inwards
Standing, proud style: straight back arms move as if marching to a lesser degree
Standing, punch style: punch with every step
Standing, quail style: arms straight by sides slightly back very small quick steps
Standing, raised left arm style: raise left arm perpendicular to body
Standing, raised right arm style: raise right arm perpendicular to body
Standing, right hop style: hop on right foot
Standing, roadrunner style: arms behind as wings pick up knees - bent a little
Standing, robot style: stiff movements arms bending at elbows
Standing, rocket style: bent to flat back with hands behind as thrusters
Standing, rushed style: rushing about swinging arms for extra momentum
Standing, shielded left style: squat down with left arm raised in block as if holding a shield above head. Right arm as if holding a sword
Standing, shielded right style: squat down with right arm raised in block as if holding a shield above head. Left arm as if holding a sword
Standing, skip style: skipping like a child
Standing, slide feet style: barely lift feet off the floor/kick into floor
Standing, star style: wide arms and legs. Arms slightly below horizontal
Standing, start stop style: pause briefly after step
Standing, stiff style: stiff limbs arms straight
Standing, strutting style: with swagger leant slightly back arms swinging freely
Standing, superman style: right arm raised like superman flying
Standing, swat style: as if holding a rifle and raiding a building
Standing, sweep style: sweeping with a broom while moving
Standing, swimming style: breaststroke walking
Standing, swing arms round style: swing arms round body (right in front left at back then switch)
Standing, swing shoulders style: rotate torso and shoulders left to right and back
Standing, teapot style: one arm on hip other arm raised
Standing, tiptoe style: walk on toes with heels raised
Standing, together step style: step left foot - then together – then right foot
Standing, two foot jump style: feet together and jump
Standing, walking stick left style: walk with a stick – used broom handle
Standing, walking stick right style: walk with a stick – used broom handle
Standing, waving style: waving at somebody else at random
Standing, whirl arms style: windmill arms
Standing, wide legs style: legs apart motions
Standing, wiggle hips style: hands raised in front of body wiggle hips side to side
Standing, wild arms style: swing arms much more than normal almost punching into the air
Standing, wild legs style: kick legs into the air with each step
Standing, zombie style: arms in front like zombie
